semiconductor_relevance: High — Lim Chemical Co., Ltd. provides specialized equipment and systems that are integral to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Lim Chemical Co., Ltd. offers a range of equipment and chemical supply systems tailored for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-quality products and services since 1984. Their offerings include advanced monitoring systems, gas generators, and various components essential for semiconductor fabrication and processing.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has been serving customers in Taiwan since its establishment, indicating a strong local presence.
